title: cockpit.config.json
description: Static, per-repo configuration for the Claude-Science-Cockpit. Never written by the cockpit itself; Claude never sees or edits it through any MCP tool. See projectdocs/claude-science-cockpit/phases/design/cockpit-config-schema.md for the full design rationale.

repo.description: The exact GitHub owner/repo this config is bound to. Every cockpit call verifies this against the repo's actual `git remote get-url origin` and refuses on any mismatch (the anti-wrong-folder guard).

paths.description: Repo-relative paths. Resolved to absolute paths from the verified repo root at load time — never inherited from PLANKTON_DIR/NEKTON_DIR/etc. environment variables.

identity.description: This cockpit instance's own signing identity. Reused across sessions — never regenerated automatically (regenerating orphans any claims already signed under the old key).

verbs.description: Which of the three verbs are active. Claude has no way to enable a disabled verb.

claims.description: The claim-template ceiling for cockpit_say. Claude can request one of these; it can never invent a new claim shape.

trust.description: Named trust tiers, each a list of pubkey paths (repo-relative or absolute). The ceiling for cockpit_ask's filter — a query can narrow within these tiers, never surface a tier/signer outside them.

reproduction.description: The reproduction precondition policy cockpit_say runs itself before writing a reproduces claim's level field — never self-declared by Claude.
